notes.title: WARNING ! Before you Play
notes.notes:
[b] Don't Play this game if :[/b] 
You are afraid in the dark.
Terrifying sounds make you shiver.
A jumpscare makes your heart stop.
You are afraid to get lost in the woods.
Be prey of a predator makes you howl.
You believe in the supernatural or in very bad things.
You live alone and your nights are full of nightmares
